lines.zh: 我一段一段往前挪，壳很重。
lines.en: I inch forward in segments, my shell heavy.
I crawl over sand, leaving a deep groove.
I have many legs, and they move in disorder.

lines.zh: 我拖着腹部，沙都陷下去。
lines.en: I drag my belly, and the sand sinks.
I crawl toward the heat.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块原石，没有绕远。
lines.en: I go around an originium chunk without detouring.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转向你的方向。
lines.en: I turn slowly your way.
My shell scrapes the ground, loudly.

lines.zh: 我在源石沙漠走了很久。
lines.en: I've walked the oridesert a long time.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每一步都很沉。
lines.en: I don't move fast, but every step is heavy.
I climb a sand ridge and stop.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤过去，壳擦破了。
lines.en: I squeeze through a rock gap, scraping my shell.

lines.zh: 我压过沙丘，沙子往下流。
lines.en: I crush over the dune and the sand slides away.
I grind forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，虫子都跑了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the bugs flee.
I raise my head to find that smell.
I lower my body and keep crawling.

lines.zh: 我转过一块石头，看见了你。
lines.en: I round a stone and see you.
I lie in the sand, my shell half buried.
My legs twitch now and then.
I wait for a stir in the sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢消化昨天吞下的石头。
lines.en: I slowly digest the stones I swallowed yesterday.
A crust of crystal covers me.
The sun bleaches the sand.
I grow slowly, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有震动。
lines.en: I hear a tremor far off.
I draw my legs in to rest.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让沙动了一下。
lines.en: My breathing stirs the sand.

lines.zh: 我记得以前这里没这么干。
lines.en: I remember this place wasn't so dry.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，看不见了。
lines.en: I lower my head until I can't see.
You've stepped onto my sand.
I raise my head; you look small.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在壳缝里亮着。
lines.en: My eyes glow through the shell's seams.
No crystal on you; strange.
I smell water on you.
My jaws move once.
You're too near my sand.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的壳上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell.

lines.zh: 你不是我见过的那种猎物。
lines.en: You're not the prey I've seen before.

lines.zh: 你的脚步一响，我就数一节。
lines.en: Each of your steps, I count a segment.
A crack opens in my shell.
I flinch, and the sand slides.
I back off two paces, my legs flailing.
That slowed me a lot.
I shake off the loose sand.
I don't cry out; I only rumble low.
I flatten and recover.
My jaws won't close.

lines.zh: 黑的东西从裂缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Something black seeps from the crack.
I'm still upright, not flipped.
That smell of water; I follow it.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋水在往下滴。
lines.en: That water skin of yours is dripping.

lines.zh: 那股味道让我多爬了两步。
lines.en: That smell pulls me two more steps your way.
You carry the smell of originium.
I extend my jaws and close them slowly.
Set it down, and I'll stop.
That smell makes me forget the pain.
A little closer, let me be sure.
That bright thing is mine.

lines.zh: 我跟着那股味转了个方向。
lines.en: I turn to follow the smell.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，自己跌坐下去。
lines.en: You hit my leg and drop down on your own.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了一点，继续爬。
lines.en: I'm nudged aside and keep crawling.
My legs catch on your boot.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You step on my shell, and I sway.
The sand collapses between us.
I turn, and my shell hits you.

lines.zh: 你的剑在我壳上滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，很慢很重。
lines.en: I butt you once, slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 我们滚在一起，沙进你眼睛。
lines.en: We roll together, sand in your eyes.
I pull back, and sand covers my legs.

lines.zh: 另一只从沙丘后面爬出来。
lines.en: Another crawls out from behind the dune.
Her shell is brighter than mine.
We lie side by side in the sand.
She rests a leg on my shell.
We dig a pit together.
Her jaws are a little smaller.
We share one patch of shade.

lines.zh: 沙里有我们两个人的痕。
lines.en: The sand holds marks of both of us.
We don't speak; we understand.
At dark, we lean together.
I clamp a piece of originium in my jaws.
I drag your sword into the sand.
I pick up a bone and bury it.
I drag away your dropped shield.

lines.zh: 我扒出一块发亮的石头。
lines.en: I dig out a shining stone.
I pick up a bug and eat it.

lines.zh: 我把你的披风拽到身下。
lines.en: I haul your cloak under me.
I clamp an arrow and snap it.
I bite open the water skin on the ground.

lines.zh: 我拖了一块木板，拖不动。
lines.en: I drag a plank and can't move it.
You've walked on my sand a long while.
The sand moved; I heard it.
I raise my head and lock on.
My jaws have opened.

lines.zh: 沙子底下有道旧痕，是我留的。
lines.en: There's an old groove under the sand that I made.

lines.zh: 你跑到沙丘后面也没用。
lines.en: Hide behind the dune; it won't help.
I come from beneath.
You carry water; I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我把陷进沙的腿抽起来。
lines.en: I pull my sand-buried legs free.
I veer your way.
This time I won't wait.
The line under the sand is me.

lines.zh: 你踩过的沙还热，我跟上去。
lines.en: The sand you stepped on is still warm; I follow it.
A ridge rises in the sand.
You halt, and my legs halt.
Beneath the sand I circle ahead of you.
The sand under your step is caving.
I flatten and hide.
I'm a short stretch from you.
Do you hear the sand?
I close my jaws and open them.
You look back and see only the sand heave.
The sun is high; I don't mind.
I dig slowly, patiently.
I burst from the sand and hit you.
My jaws close on your leg.
I whip my head and throw you off.
My legs catch your hand.
I drag your foot down.
Sand flies into your face.

lines.zh: 我横过身子，把你扫进沙里。
lines.en: I swing my body sideways and sweep you into the sand.
I press you down, my shell heavy.
You struggle, and I hold harder.
I let go, and you get up again.
The sand splits, and I come up.

lines.zh: 我从深处爬上来，带着热。
lines.en: I crawl up from deep, warm with it.
The sand is too dry; exactly right.
First I bury myself.
My shell still holds dampness.
There are no other sounds in the desert.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，壳上的沙落下。
lines.en: I shake, and sand slides off my shell.
Something walks the sand.
I look up and see smoke far off.
This is my place.
I slowly unfold my legs.
When I appear, the sand collapses.

lines.zh: 火烤得壳都脆了，我钻沙。
lines.en: The heat makes my shell brittle; I burrow.

lines.zh: 我掉进自己的坑里，翻了。
lines.en: I fall into my own pit and flip.
Once wet, sand sticks all over my shell.

lines.zh: 气浪把沙和我一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast throws sand and me together.
An arrow lodges in a shell seam and won't come out.
A spell pins my legs.
Hunger weakens my legs.
Lightning turns the sand to glass.
No sand; my legs find no grip.
